item.title: FreqDroid 1.2: Rich Exit Notifications and Notification History
item.author: me@codeskraps.com (codeskraps)
item.description: FreqDroid 1.2 is out with two notification upgrades: a new in-app notification history screen and support for rich exit notifications via FreqTrade’s strategy callback — giving you Telegram-style trade alerts without Telegram.
